item.title: Johnson: Trump's $5,000 checks need Congress approval
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson said President Trump's plan to send $5,000 dividend checks to adult U.S. citizens would require congressional approval.

item.title: America's borrowing binge comes with a rising cost

item.title: Johnson urges AI solutions but says Congress won't lead
